changes.comment: The package is now part of a Rush monorepo. `viteburner` remains the CLI and re-exports the plugin; the plugin is also published separately as `@viteburner/vite-plugin`.
Requires Node.js 20.19 or newer and Vite 7.
Upgraded to Vite 7, Vitest 5 and vite-plugin-dts 5. `import.meta.glob` tracking no longer relies on Vite's internal `_importGlobMap`.

CLI keyboard shortcuts work again. `q` and `Esc` are ordinary shortcuts that do nothing when no session is active, while `Ctrl+C` and `Ctrl+D` always terminate the process, including while a prompt is open.
The key map is now the single source of truth for shortcuts, and the help output lists `h`.
Changing `viteburner` configuration no longer tears down the replacement dev server; the watched files are re-scanned and uploaded after the restart.
Added `getPluginConfig()` to read the resolved plugin configuration.
The CLI control channel no longer travels over the Vite WebSocket, so no HMR port is reserved and no separate CLI client is created.
Fixed `vite.config.*` being evaluated twice, which broke function-form Vite configs.
Fixed the bundled declarations to use type-only imports that resolve under Node16/NodeNext module resolution.
Fixed a watched file that matches no configured location being thrown instead of reported in the log.
